quiz.alt01: A rainy day with nowhere to be. What do you do?
quiz.alt01_a: Wander out anyway and see who else is out.
quiz.alt01_b: Stay in and tinker with your gear.
quiz.alt01_c: Check that your Pokémon are warm and dry.
quiz.alt01_e: Make a game of the puddles.
quiz.alt02: A stranger asks you for directions, and you only half know the way.
quiz.alt02_b: Draw a careful map from what you know.
quiz.alt02_c: Say what you know and admit what you do not.
quiz.alt02_d: Ask other travelers and piece it together.
quiz.alt02_e: Point the way you feel is right.
quiz.alt03: A rival leaves you a gift before the next gym.
quiz.alt03_b: Wonder what it is meant to say.
quiz.alt03_c: Keep it safe and thank them.
quiz.alt03_d: Use it to win, and tell them so.
quiz.alt03_e: Leave it closed until you are ready.
quiz.alt04: A loud noise wakes you in the night.
quiz.alt04_c: Listen and wait for it to come again.
quiz.alt04_e: Slip out the back, just in case.
quiz.alt05: An unfinished puzzle sits on a table in the lab.
quiz.alt05_a: Work it out piece by piece.
quiz.alt05_d: Finish it first, to prove you can.
quiz.alt05_e: Leave it. Some things are not yours.
quiz.alt06: A stormy crossing: the ferry may not run.
quiz.alt06_b: Check the charts and the sky.
quiz.alt06_c: Make sure the others are safe first.
quiz.alt06_d: Wait it out and trust your sense of it.
quiz.q01: You find an injured Pokémon on the road. What do you do?
quiz.q01_a: Approach and help it right away.
quiz.q01_b: Examine the situation before touching anything.
quiz.q01_c: Make it comfortable before going near.
quiz.q01_e: Give it space and let it come to you.
quiz.q02: A Trainer far stronger than you challenges you.
quiz.q02_b: Ask what made them so strong.
quiz.q02_c: Find a way to beat them with strategy.
quiz.q02_d: Refuse to back down, whatever the odds.
quiz.q03: What makes a Pokémon truly strong?
quiz.q04: You discover something that could change the world and nobody believes you.
quiz.q04_d: Keep it secret until you understand it.
quiz.q04_e: Ask your Pokémon to help you look.
quiz.q05: Your closest Pokémon refuses to battle.
quiz.q06: You lose a battle you were sure you would win. What is the first thing you do?
quiz.q06_a: Replay it in your head to find the mistake.
quiz.q06_b: Ask for a rematch right now.
quiz.q06_c: Check on your Pokémon before anything else.
quiz.q06_e: Laugh it off; you learned something.
quiz.q07: Where do you feel most at home?
quiz.q08: An unfamiliar Pokémon steps out of the tall grass.
quiz.q08_c: Back off slowly and give it room.
quiz.q09: A cave-in blocks the exit with you, a stranger and both your Pokémon inside.
quiz.q09_a: Start digging; plan as you go.
quiz.q09_b: Map the cave and look for another way.
quiz.q09_d: Go ahead alone to find help.
quiz.q09_e: Wait and read how the rock is settling.
quiz.q10: Which is the real mark of a good Trainer?
quiz.q10_d: Being able to stand alone if needed.
quiz.q11: What do you value most in a friend?
quiz.q11_b: Showing up when it is hard.
quiz.q12: You are offered something you have wanted for years, but taking it means breaking a promise.
quiz.q12_c: Find a way to do both.
quiz.q12_d: Ask the other person what they would want.
